mapper.select: SELECT * FROM publish_attempt WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE publish_attempt SET status = 'succeeded', failed_step = NULL, error_message = NULL, fallback_task_type = NULL, fallback_target_type = NULL, fallback_target_id = NULL, fallback_failure_reason = NULL, fallback_next_retry_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId}
UPDATE publish_attempt SET status = 'failed', failed_step = #{failedStep}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId}
mapper.select: SELECT attempt_id, post_id, creator_id, idempotent_key, status, failed_step, error_message, retry_count, created_at, updated_at FROM publish_attempt WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE publish_attempt SET status = 'publishing', failed_step = NULL, error_message = NULL, fallback_task_type = NULL, fallback_target_type = NULL, fallback_target_id = NULL, fallback_failure_reason = NULL, fallback_next_retry_at = NULL, retry_count = retry_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND status = 'failed'
